summary: Private installs only run their update build resources while building, which keeps cost down.

new.title: Build resources run only when needed
new.text: On a private network install, the resources that build updates now start only for a build and stop afterwards, even when the build fails.

fixes.title: Do not install this release
fixes.text: This release was replaced by 2.0.76, because its update stops before installing anything. Use 2.0.76 or later.
